alerts.alert_title_en: Climate Action Becomes Fully Integrated Cross-Sector Issue
alerts.description_en: Climate topics appear simultaneously across all six PESTLE dimensions, indicating a holistic shift toward redefining prosperity through integrated sustainable development combining traditional knowledge and modern technology.

alerts.alert_title_en: Strait of Hormuz Becomes Critical Geopolitical Flashpoint
alerts.description_en: Coverage of the Strait of Hormuz surged 25,000-fold as the Trump administration applies pressure on Iran to reopen the waterway while shifting responsibility to Europe, signaling a major restructuring of global energy security governance.

alerts.alert_title_en: Strait of Hormuz Enters Global Policy Agenda Formally
alerts.description_en: The phrase 'strait hormuz' appears 197 times as a new topic, indicating that Hormuz reopening negotiations have formally emerged as a central global policy issue for the first time in recent years.

alerts.alert_title: アルテミス計画の急増

alerts.alert_title_en: Orban's Hungary Becomes Trump-Europe Strategic Battleground

alerts.alert_title_en: Economic Crisis Signals Emerge Across All Sectors

alerts.alert_title_en: Global Rule Systems Face Fundamental Reordering

alerts.alert_title_en: Big Law Firms Take Political Stance Against Trump

alerts.alert_title_en: Iran Ceasefire Becomes Formal Policy Topic
